title.narrative: R2D Syunik: Recovery, Resilience, Development for Syunik

description.narrative:
R2D Syunik will enhance recovery and resilience of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) and rehabilitate sustainable small-scale community infrastructures in Syunik. The project comprises three outcomes:

1.      Outcome 1 aims for an improved business environment for MSMEs, resulting in improved competitiveness and sustainability of the private sector while following a gender equality approach. Outcome 1 focuses on:

a.      Improved access of MSMEs to knowledge, technologies, services, markets, and finance

b.      Enhanced capacities of entrepreneurs and employees (with a particular focus on empowering disadvantaged groups)

2.      Outcome 2 aims to improve the availability of sustainable, green community infrastructures:

a.         Sustainable small-scale green community infrastructures are rehabilitated and maintained

b.         Bankable community infrastructure projects are prioritized and prepared in the communities

3.      Outcome 3 aims to improve multi-stakeholder dialogue for regional development in Syunik:

a.         Regular multi-stakeholder coordination for the regional development of Syunik is taking place
